head: wave 11 integrated: AR047 (rule test harness) + AR061 (derived SQLite index) + AR062 (public library API) + AR086 (hostile-input hardening)
notes: The baseline may only be TIGHTENED: a metric may move in the improving
direction freely; ratchet_check.py fails when any metric regresses past
its recorded value. Values below are measured exactly the way
tools/ratchet_check.py measures them, so the gate is reproducible.
ruff_total is REPO-WIDE (`ruff check .` concise, pyproject select) since
wave 9. The previously recorded 137 was a src-only, explicit --select
scope that the gate itself cannot reproduce; the number moved 137 -> 652
by scope correction plus new code, not by a quality drop - the same scope
measures 659 at the pre-wave tree (f00892b).
wave 10 tightened ruff 652 -> 649, mypy 539 -> 538 / files 70 -> 69 and
modules 180 -> 183 (model/ledger, reasoning/rules/evaluation,
surfaces/rules_cli). The strict island (ci.yml types job) stays
blocking-clean at the post-AR030 native homes.
wave 11 (AR047+AR061+AR062+AR086): the two lane regressions were
reverted within the wave (ruff back to 649 via the api.py import-order
fix; broad_excepts back to 63 via narrowing sqlite.py's BaseException to
(sqlite3.Error, OSError)), so ruff/mypy/broad_excepts hold at the wave 10
values; modules 183 -> 190 (orchestration/derived_index x4,
surfaces/api, surfaces/index_cli).
import_cycles 41 -> 0 and layer violations 27 -> 0 in wave 9 (AR030);
wave 10 (AR031 slice 2) turned enforcement on for __init__ aggregators
too (12 enforced) and retired the flat transition map. Both ratchet
files are kept as explicit empty baselines.
coverage_floor stays 21 (AC-004 ratchet); the fast selection measured
37.71% at the wave 9 head - raising the floor is a deliberate follow-up,
not piggybacked on wave integration.
Known non-regressions in the suite (11): output_exclusion 6, scanner
2 (flask blueprint + path normalization), local_provider_timeouts 2,
regex_budget 1 - all verified failing at pre-wave trees.
Process rule learned in wave 10: after a structural wave re-run the
whole non-live selection, not only `-m 'unit or contract'`. Wave 9 moved
53 src files and left one moved monkeypatch target
(analyzer_catalog.get_analyzer_catalog) failing in tests/integration;
the fast selection cannot see that tier.
